title: Kit and dependency contracts before implementation
summary: The decision defines pure kit descriptors, separate declaration/Worker/Node entries, canonical provenance, one dependency graph, source integrity and one-blank Promise/Effect dependency wrappers. Independent review caught and closed a client import leak by separating pure dependency declarations from runtime implementations.
